# Additions merged into the U-Boot environment. Not a full environment.
# Install as /boot/thoxos.env.txt on the vendor image. boot.cmd imports this
# with `env import -t` after the vendor environment is already loaded.
# sun60iw2p1_t736_defconfig sets CONFIG_ENV_IS_IN_EXT4=y and does not name
# the ext4 env file (no CONFIG_ENV_EXT4_FILE in that defconfig). Importing
# this text from the boot script does not by itself rewrite that saved env,
# and it does not retroactively change the bootdelay of the current boot.
# bootdelay and stderr take effect on a later boot only if something saves
# them into the env store U-Boot actually loads.
#
# thox_sku is the default. boot.cmd also defaults it to thoxmini when unset.
# A value already in the saved environment, or in /boot/orangepiEnv.txt
# imported after this file, overrides it.

thox_sku=thoxmini
thox_image_id=thoxos-opi3w-1.0.0
bootdelay=1
stderr=serial
